services.desc: Our Potential, Our Purpose is an interactive exhibit that explores how communities around the world are building opportunity, resilience, and positive change. Through stories, visuals, and hands-on elements, visitors are invited to reflect on global challenges and shared solutions, and discover how individuals and communities are shaping a more inclusive and sustainable future. This exhibit showcases people taking on big challenges like inequality and climate change, and explore what it means to be part of a global community and imagine your role in a world full of potential.
